author: Vox
description:
Democrats just won back power in the midterms, so why was it so hard to get them to answer a simple survey about what they want to do with it?

We asked Democratic insiders four questions about the future of their party at the What’s Next summit in Denver. When almost no one responded, it raised the question: Do Democrats actually have a plan?

It depends on who you ask. US Sen. Raphael Warnock (D-GA) answered our survey questions in a candid conversation, where he broke down why voters haven’t necessarily fallen in love with the Democratic brand and why the party must center people over politics.
